releaseIdMeaning: the grid's completion marker (tiles.complete.sha256), which data/phase6-coarse-grid-tiles.json binds

siteBinding.name: COARSE_GRID_BASE
siteBinding.setBy: the owner, on the live site, through the ChatGPT Sites control plane

claims.releasedMeaning: Uploaded create-once to the release prefix and read back byte for byte from S3 and CloudFront. The draw-and-measure route reads it once the live site's COARSE_GRID_BASE names this base.

limits: Loss is counted once per place against the forest known at the start year; the yearly sum is hectares only, never a share.
Edge blocks of a drawn shape are bracketed, not measured; the route reports the bracket.
Every province is partially mapped, so every figure is a minimum. Nodata is Unknown, never zero.
